item.title: Shiraito Waterfall: Fukui's 'White Thread' Cascade — Guide
item.description: Shiraito Waterfall takes its name, meaning ‘white thread’, from the way its water spreads and separates into fine, thread-like strands as it cascades down a broad rock face, a gentler and more delicate sight than a single powerful drop of water. Set within a quiet forested valley, the falls are easily accessible via a short walk from nearby parking, making them a good stop for visitors seeking a peaceful natural spot without a demanding hike.
